source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes mutually independent uncertain edges, proves that a valid identifying formula remains valid in every edge-induced subgraph, and establishes NP-completeness of edge ID, which optimizes a deleted-edge set yielding one identifiable graph.
Proposition 1 states that ID fails iff a hedge exists for the original query, alongside two equivalent intrinsic-set characterizations.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 10--12, Definition 6, Algorithm 2 discussion, and Lemma 7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article defines minimal hedges, uses iterative hedge discovery to solve a minimum hitting-set intervention problem, explicitly notes that enumerating all hedges is exponential, and states that Algorithm 2 returns an optimal solution.
The paper provides FPT preprocessing and fixed-parameter-linear delay for minimal transversals of an explicit bounded-treewidth hypergraph.
The paper establishes #P-completeness of source-sink reliability even for acyclic directed planar networks of maximum degree three.
